svg.title: Maps within maps — 016 / The unreachable field — 27 June responders
svg.desc: Maps within maps: 016 / The unreachable field, 27 June responders. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 dark. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response lit, correction dark, configuration dark, weights dark. Responders model another run; TENTATIVE ATTRIBUTION / INTERIOR UNKNOWN. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted.
svg.text: OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC TERRAIN / NO MEASURED BELIEFS

g.text: OUTER VIEWPOINT HOLDS A MODEL / THE MODEL DOES NOT BECOME ANOTHER PERSON'S INTERIOR

svg.text: NO ONE IN THIS STORY CAN SEE THIS PAGE. THIS MAP DOES NOT UPDATE.
016.2–5 / OAI-BH, one conference talk; no independent review
